description.text:
Role Purpose
Acting as the critical bridge between local business and group/regional IT, you will ensure that all SAP and retail application systems are maintained, optimized, and aligned with both regional and global IT guidelines. You will focus on the reliability and continuous improvement of systems supporting our stores, and office.
Key Responsibilities
1. SAP & Application Support
• Ensure that ERP (SAP), POS, Retail Applications operate efficiently.
• Manage configurations, upgrades, and troubleshooting in coordination with users and regional/group IT.
• Log and track all incidents via the ticketing system, performing root cause analysis for timely resolution.
2. System Administration & Data Integrity
• Perform system configuration and user administration tasks.
• Develop and maintain data interfaces, exports/imports, and ensure high-performance data exchange between SAP and local systems.
• Proactively monitor system alerts and perform quality checks to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
3. Process Optimization & Projects
• Analyze retail business processes and produce data flow diagrams to recommend usability improvements.
• Support application-related projects, providing technical input for regional rollouts and local deployments.
• Ensure all system changes align with corporate standards, governance, and Group IT security.
4. Stakeholder Coordination
• Collaborate closely with group/regional IT, local business users, and vendors.
• Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, procedures, and user guides.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Technical Skills:
1. Proven expertise in SAP Retail
2. Proficiency in SQL / PL-SQL and ERP application management.
3. Strong ability to translate business needs into technical actions.
4. Soft Skills: Effective communication skills for working within a matrix reporting line; detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities.
Key Success Indicators
1. Uptime: High application availability and performance across retail sites.
2. Service: Ticket resolution strictly within agreed SLAs.
3. Quality: Maintenance of data accuracy across the ERP, POS and WMS landscape.
4. Compliance: Full alignment with group IT standards and successful audit support.
